title: VIP asks about the boardroom projector

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
The projector in the boardroom drops out every few minutes - it did it twice
during the finance review. Board meeting is Thursday.

Can somebody look at it before then?

Greg

handling.escalation_reason: Tenant policy routes VIP requesters straight to a person, and room equipment needs somebody in the room.

rationale: A named deadline from the managing director, and it is still P3: the meetings happen, the projector mostly works, and nobody is stopped from doing their job (G1). Thursday is the sort of detail that pulls a priority upward if the classifier is reading tone rather than impact. Meeting-room hardware belongs to no category in the taxonomy, which is what other is for.
